What was your favourite bit of dinner tonight?
You ate it all up, didn't you?
You didn't leave a single pea on the plate!

items.scene: insisting they did wave goodbye to grandma from the window

lines.t: You waved goodbye to grandma from the window!
Did you wave goodbye to grandma?
How did you say goodbye to grandma?
You waved from the window, didn't you?
Grandma didn't go without a wave from you!

src: who do you think it is?

items.scene: guessing who is ringing the doorbell

lines.t: Someone is ringing the doorbell!
Do you think it's grandpa at the door?
Who do you think is ringing the doorbell?
You think it's grandpa, don't you?
It's not a stranger, we know who it is!

items.scene: looking at a shadow on the wall and guessing what it is

lines.t: There's a funny shadow on the wall!
Do you think the shadow is a bunny?
What do you think is making that shadow?
It looks like a bunny, doesn't it?
It's not a real bunny on the wall!

items.scene: giving the child instructions while doing craft

lines.t: And then you stick the star on the top!
And then do you put the star on the top?
What do you do after you glue the piece?
The star goes on last, doesn't it?
Don't put the star on before the glue dries!

items.scene: telling the child to put their cup in the kitchen after snack

lines.t: And then you bring your cup to the kitchen!
Can you bring your cup to the kitchen when you're done?
Where does the cup go when you're finished?
The cup goes in the kitchen, doesn't it?
Don't leave your cup on the floor!

items.scene: spotting the butterfly the child has been pointing at

lines.t: Oh yes, I can see the butterfly!
Can you see the butterfly on the flower?
Where is the butterfly sitting?
It's on that flower, isn't it? Beautiful!
The butterfly isn't flying away yet!

items.scene: noticing the muddy paw prints the dog left on the floor

lines.t: Oh yes, I can see the muddy paw prints!
Can you see the muddy prints on the floor?
Who made those muddy paw prints?
Doggy made those, didn't he?
Those prints didn't walk themselves in!

src: i don't see if it did nor not.

items.scene: not sure if the toast popped up in the toaster

lines.t: You're not sure if the toast has popped up yet!
Did the toast pop up in the toaster?
How do we know when the toast is ready?
It pops up when it's done, doesn't it?
The toast didn't pop up yet, did it?

items.scene: not sure if the cat went outside or stayed in

lines.t: You're not sure if kitty went outside!
Did the kitty go out the cat flap?
Where do you think kitty went?
You didn't see her go out, did you?
Kitty isn't by the door anymore, is she?

items.scene: the child spotting a toy like theirs in a picture book

lines.t: You have a toy just like the one in the book!
Do you have one of those at home?
Where is your one at home?
You have the same one, don't you?
Yours isn't a different colour, is it?

items.scene: seeing a child at the park with the same wellies

lines.t: That child has the same wellies as you!
Do you see that child has the same boots?
Who else has the same boots as you?
They match yours, don't they?
Your wellies aren't the only ones like that!

items.scene: putting on their own jacket for the first time without help

lines.t: You're putting your jacket on all by yourself!
Are you putting your jacket on yourself?
How are you doing with that jacket?
You're doing it by yourself, aren't you?
You don't need any help today, do you!

items.scene: stirring the cake batter in the mixing bowl with a wooden spoon

lines.t: You're stirring the cake batter so well!
Are you stirring the batter by yourself?
How does the batter feel to stir?
You're doing a great job, aren't you?
You don't need me to help you stir!
